text:
maya: Heads-up: candidate model submitted for onboarding — 'orca-lite-15b-ptx' (community fork). Requesting quick priority/handoff and an eval plan for quant/FP16->int8 experiments. Upload here: s3://redwood-models/incoming/orca-lite-15b-ptx.tar.gz. TL;DR: unstable on summarization in early smoke runs.

sam: Thanks. Can you drop a short checklist of required evals? I'll slot into next intake sprint.

maya: Checklist draft: 1) Sanity smoke (token-run, start-to-finish inference) 2) Core prompt suite (prod prompts + edge cases) 3) Quant sensitivity (int8, int4 if possible) 4) Compare vs baseline 'redwood-compat-13b' on our eval harness 5) Hallucination smoke + safety checks 6) Latency/P50/P95 on a1/gpu pools 7) Canary rollout plan

jordan: For pass/fail, suggest thresholds: - Relative latency <= baseline *1.3 - Major quality regressions: mean acceptability drop <= 0.05 (5%) on core suite - Hallucination increase <= 2% absolute - Any regression with p<0.05 flagged. Thoughts?

ali: Agree but be conservative on hallucinations. Also add embedding regression check (cosine drift <= 0.03).

eva: I'll own eval harness runs. Proposed commands: 
```
./run_eval.py --model s3://redwood-models/incoming/orca-lite-15b-ptx.tar.gz --suite core-suite --baseline redwood-compat-13b --quant int8,int4
```
I'll output CSVs into `s3://redwood-evals/2109876543/`

ci-bot: CI: Eval job queued: eval-harness/orca-lite-15b-ptx/1. Expect ~2.5h. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345

sam: @eva can you include prompt perturbations and instruction-following Likert scores? We'll need human eval sample if delta close to thresholds.

eva: Yes — will do automatic metrics + 200-sample crowd eval if automatic deltas > 0.03 on acceptability.

maya: Can we add a prioritization decision tree? Quick idea: if automatic pass on core suite + latency ok -> proceed to dedicated canary. If automatic fail -> triage + model owner feedback. If mixed -> human eval trigger.

jordan: Canary config suggestion: 1) 1% traffic for 24h; 2) monitor rerank/error rate, refresh eval daily; 3) auto-roll back if user-facing task degradation >= 4% or errors spike 2x.

ali: Note: quant experiments might mask some hallucination increases — tag each run with quant profile and disable auto-canary until int8 passes.

eva: I'll add metadata columns: quant_profile, seed, tokenizer_version, compile_flags. Also will compute bootstrap CI for deltas.

sam: :thumbsup: owners: eva -> eval runs; ali -> quant experiments; maya -> model intake owner; jordan -> canary runbook. I'll open intake ticket with these owners and link results.

maya: Thanks. Opening ticket: https://issues.redwood/ML-6921 assigned to @sam. I'll also attach prompt suite list.

ci-bot: Ticket created ML-6921 by maya. Status: triage.
